newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenian president to make rare visit to Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Armenian president to make rare visit to Turkey.

text.p: Armenian President Levon Ter-Petrosyan plans to visit Turkey, Armenia's traditional adversary, next week, a spokesman said on Friday.
He said Ter-Petrosyan would head an Armenian delegation to the Black Sea countries economic cooperation forum in Istanbul from April 28 to 30.
"Despite his busy schedule Ter-Petrosyan accepted the invitation of Turkey's President Suleyman Demirel", he said.
The two nations have no diplomatic relations and a history of tense relations. Christian Armenia says Turks massacred 1.5 million Armenians in 1915, a figure Turkey says is grossly exaggeraged.
Ter-Petrosyan was among those who laid flowers on Thursday to the victims of the massacre in a commemoration ceremony.
Relations were further strained in the mid 1980s when Turkey backed fellows Moslems in Azerbaijan fighting Armenian forces over the territory of Nagorno-Karabakh.
Ter-Petrosyan has previously visited Turkey in 1993 to attend President Turgut Ozal's funeral.
